description: This file defines the EmployeeSalary entity class within the OrangeHRM system, which maps to the 'hs_hr_emp_basicsalary' database table. It includes properties such as employee details, salary amount, pay grade, currency type, pay period, and comments, along with getter and setter methods for each attribute.

classes.name: EmployeeSalary
classes.description: Entity class representing the employee salary details with ORM mappings and accessor methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the salary record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the salary record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this salary.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee entity with this salary.

methods.name: getPayGrade
methods.description: Returns the PayGrade entity linked to this salary, if any.

methods.name: setPayGrade
methods.description: Sets the PayGrade entity for this salary.

methods.name: getCurrencyType
methods.description: Returns the CurrencyType entity for this salary.

methods.name: setCurrencyType
methods.description: Sets the CurrencyType entity for this salary.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the salary amount as a string, if set.

methods.name: getPayPeriod
methods.description: Returns the PayPeriod entity linked to this salary.

methods.name: setPayPeriod
methods.description: Associates a PayPeriod with this salary.

methods.name: getSalaryName
methods.description: Returns the name of the salary component.

methods.name: setSalaryName
methods.description: Sets the name of the salary component.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns any comments associated with this salary.

methods.name: getDirectDebit
methods.description: Returns the direct debit configuration associated with this salary, if any.

methods.name: setDirectDebit
methods.description: Associates a direct debit configuration with this salary.
